results.title: Database stops while the site is in use
results.failure_injected: PostgreSQL stopped (0.1 s), then started again
results.expected: Requests fail within seconds with a clear message (503), nothing half-saved; the API reconnects by itself when the database is back
results.observed: while down: API /health 503 in 0.01 s, website /api/health 503 in 0.02 s, Found page 503 in 0.0 s ('{"detail":"TraceBack is briefly unavailable. Please try again in a moment."}'), new report 503; internals leaked: False. After the restart: healthy 0.0 s after PostgreSQL was started, without restarting the API; the student's session still works (200); half-saved reports: 0

results.title: Database restarts while 10 students are browsing
results.failure_injected: PostgreSQL stopped for 3 s under load
results.expected: Requests during the restart fail fast; every request after it succeeds; no restart of the API needed
results.observed: 11228 requests from 10 users over 30 s; database down from 8.3 s to 11.4 s; 2411 requests failed, the last one started at 11.35 s; after the restart: 4406 requests, 0 failed; slowest request 0.21 s; failures by kind {'503': 2407, 'RemoteProtocolError': 4}

results.title: API process crashes
results.failure_injected: Both API processes killed with kill -9, then started again (in production Docker restarts them: restart: unless-stopped)
results.expected: The website answers at once with an error instead of hanging; after the restart, sessions, reports and photos are all still there
results.observed: API processes killed (kill -9). While down: website /api/health 500 in 0.03 s, Found page 200 in 0.03 s. API healthy 0.8 s after starting again. Afterwards: session 200, item 200, photo 200 (2529 bytes)

results.title: API crashes in the middle of saving reports
results.failure_injected: API killed while 8 students were sending reports
results.expected: Every confirmed report is saved; a report cut off is either saved completely (with its AI job) or not at all
results.observed: 333 reports confirmed (201) before the crash, 8 requests cut off; saved: 336; confirmed but missing: 0; saved without their AI job: 0; without their reporter: 0

results.title: Background worker is down
results.failure_injected: Worker stopped while 10 reports came in, then started
results.expected: Students can still report; the AI work waits in the queue and is done once, as soon as the worker is back
results.observed: worker stopped; 10 reports still accepted and shown (owner's page 200); 10 AI jobs waiting after 4 s; worker started: queue empty after 7.3 s; 5 of 5 lost reports got their match; 10 jobs in all (each report analysed once)

results.title: Worker is killed while it is working on an AI job
results.failure_injected: Job left 'running' by a killed worker; worker restarted
results.expected: The interrupted job is run again automatically (up to 3 tries), so the report still gets its matches
results.observed: job states afterwards: [['done', '2', '']]; report analysed for matching: True; finished 0.9 s after the worker restarted

results.title: AI providers (Groq and Gemini) are unreachable
results.failure_injected: Both LLM addresses point at a closed port
results.expected: Matching falls back to the rule-based ranking; the report still gets its suggestions; the failure is logged in the agent's audit log
results.observed: both AI providers unreachable; job done after 3.1 s; agent run outcome: fallback (LLMUnavailable: groq: APIConnectionError: Connection error.; gemini: APIConnectionError: C); rule-based match saved: True; owner's 'similar items' panel: 200, 5 suggestion(s)

results.title: Mail server is down when a student signs in
results.failure_injected: No SMTP server; then the server is restored; then it drops out for 1.5 s during a send
results.expected: The student gets a clear 'try again' message and can try again at once; the failure is logged; a short outage is bridged by the automatic retry
results.observed: no mail server: 503 in 3.05 s ("We couldn't send the email just now. Please try again."), logged as [['failed', 'ConnectionRefusedError: [Errno 111] Connection refused']]; server back, student retries at once: 202, code delivered and accepted: 200; server down for 1.5 s during a send: 202 after 3.08 s, log ['sent']

results.title: Mail server is down when a guard approves a claim
results.failure_injected: No SMTP server during the approval
results.expected: The approval is saved (the email is not part of the decision); the failed email is logged
results.observed: approve: 200 in 3.04 s; claim as the student sees it: APPROVED; approval email logged as failed (shown to staff in 'python -m app.cli email-log')

results.title: Power cut: every part stops at once
results.failure_injected: API, worker, website and PostgreSQL killed together
results.expected: Everything starts again with no data lost and no manual repair; signed-in users stay signed in
results.observed: everything killed at once (PostgreSQL in immediate mode, like a power cut). Back up in 1.7 s (database 0.0 s, API 0.8 s, website 0.7 s). Rows (users, items, claims, photos) before (7, 351, 1, 1), after (7, 351, 1, 1); session 200; photo 200; schema at 7f3a2c9d41b8; worker running: True
